description: This Java source file defines the SeoControlServlet class, a servlet responsible for handling SEO-related control logic in a web application. It extends ControlServlet and manages request routing, especially for JSP and static content, with configuration for default pages and control servlets.

classes.name: SeoControlServlet
classes.description: A servlet class for managing SEO-related control logic, extending ControlServlet, with configuration for default page and control servlet path, and handling GET requests with special routing for JSP and static content.

methods.description: Constructor for SeoControlServlet, calls superclass constructor.
